notes.title: BUG FIX PATCH – Food Cart Inc. | Version: Demo 12.06.2025
notes.content:
Hey Food Cart masters!
During today’s live demo, we tracked several issues and quickly tackled many of them. Here are the key fixes and improvements based on what we observed:
🔧 General Improvements
Order window alignment issue has been fixed.

Prep time is now shown throughout the full countdown. It also activates at the end of each day.

Burnt items now change color and display a clear tooltip.

🍔 Order & Payment System
Customers no longer accept items that don’t match the original recipe.

Overpayment caused by extra ingredients has been resolved.

The pricing system has been stabilized; incorrect high payments are fixed.


🧹 Cleanup & End-of-Day Behavior
Toppings no longer remain on the table after the base item is trashed.

Leftover sauces on plates are now properly cleared at the end of the day.

Sauce bottles are no longer mistakenly deleted at day’s end.

📘 Codex & UI
Missing or duplicate visuals have been cleaned up.

Tooltip descriptions have been completed.

Containers no longer overlap with existing items on the table.

🧍‍♂️ Customers & Performance
FPS drops and stuttering caused by excess money particles have been fixed.

Frozen customer issues after performance drops have been resolved.

First customer arrival timing has been improved.

💥 Critical Crash Fix
A rare crash that caused the game to close unexpectedly has been fixed.



Thanks for all your feedback during the demo! Keep playing — more updates are on the way!
